title: Send an e-mail from the project's outbox, after you approve it

to.description: who it goes to: plain addresses separated by commas (no names), at most 20 in all with the copies

cc.description: who is copied: plain addresses separated by commas, or the word none

subject.description: the subject: one line of at most 200 characters

body.description: the text of the e-mail, exactly as it will be sent

tasks.title: Send the e-mail
tasks.text: Prepare the e-mail for the person to approve: nothing is sent until the person approves the hash of the whole message, every recipient included.
